summary: Legal-hold export: immutable Azure Blob snapshot with RFC3161 timestamp and tenant-scoped PII tokenization
description: Issue summary: Customer requires a court-ordered legal-hold export for tenant 'ql-trading' covering activity logs, API audit records, and storage access events (90-day window). Export must be delivered as an immutable Azure Blob (WORM) container with a manifest that includes SHA-256 checksums, per-file HMAC using a customer-provided KEK, and an RFC3161 timestamp token for the manifest. Customer also requires PII tokenization for specified fields (email, ssn, account_id) using our tenant-scoped reversible tokenization keys, plus a mapping schema CSV that aligns fields to their SIEM names. Impact: This is a legal compliance request with potential regulatory review; customer cannot proceed without notarized timestamp and integrity proofs. Timeline: requested delivery within 48 hours. Acceptance criteria: (1) Immutable Azure container URL + SAS read-only link and retention locked for 365 days; (2) Manifest.json with SHA256 checksums and base64-encoded RFC3161 timestamp token; (3) HMAC envelope proofs for each file using KEK id provided by customer; (4) Tokenization map CSV and sample verification script; (5) Audit trail of export operation including operator identity, runbook step IDs, and job duration.
impact: Potential legal/regulatory exposure if notarized export not delivered. Customer's downstream auditors will block verification and escalate to legal. Blocking customer production processes that rely on archive confirmation.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer initiated legal-hold request via compliance portal and uploaded KEK id and PII field list. 2) Support attempted standard 'bulk-audit-export' job for tenant ql-trading. 3) Export job failed policy validation due to missing RFC3161 signing step in current export pipeline. 4) Manual attempt to produce artifacts created blobs but without WORM retention and without timestamp token.
logs: Export job id: export-20241112-ql-78. Storage account: rw-audit-prod. Error captured: 'pipeline:timestamp-step: not implemented' at 2024-11-12T18:42:03Z. Blob creation events: PutBlob x 12. HMAC generation partial run for 6/12 blobs. SAS generation event at 2024-11-12T19:10:11Z. Refer to logging link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/exports/export-jobs?orgId=1&var-job=export-20241112-ql-78
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: RFC3161 stamping wasn't included because our export worker uses internal timestamping library that does not call external TSA. Hypothesis 2: WORM retention requires storage account-level immutability policy — our automation path currently creates blobs but does not set immutability policies for tenant-scoped exports. Evidence: worker logs show 'timestamp_disabled=true' flag for tenant ql-trading. Partial workaround tested: post-process runner added RFC3161 token by calling TSA (openssh-rfc3161 proxy) and uploaded manifest; however this was manual and did not set retention lock. Next steps: (A) Implement export-runbook change to call external TSA service and embed the returned timestamp token in manifest. (B) Add storage account immutability step that sets a temporary legal-hold or immutability policy as allowed by customer's Azure subscription. (C) Validate HMAC generation against customer's KEK in HSM (we requested wrapped key artifact).
